# dsm_user (Data Source)

Read-only data source for looking up an existing DSM user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dsm_user" "example" {
  name = "john.doe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Username to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the user account.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is disabled.
- `email` (String) Email address for the user.
- `expire_date` (String) Date the account expires as YYYY-MM-DD, or null if it never expires.
- `groups` (List of String) List of group names the user belongs to.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the user (username).
- `two_factor_enabled` (Boolean) Whether two-factor authentication is enabled for this account.
- `uid` (Number) User ID assigned by DSM.
